_note: Batch 8: twenty REAL Perth allied health practices researched from public information on 8 Aug 2026. Introduces the 'allied' practice category (created on import): chiropractic, osteopathy, physiotherapy, podiatry, exercise physiology, speech pathology and occupational therapy. Original blurbs, all unclaimed, no copied ratings. Copy is strictly factual — registrations (AHPRA/ESSA), services, funding pathways (Medicare/NDIS/DVA/HICAPS), prices and hours; no treatment-outcome claims. Existing physio-led listings (Subiaco Sports Massage, Wellbeing Physiotherapy, Mount Lawley Physio & Podiatry, BodyFix, The Remedy) were checked for overlap and avoided.

categories.name: Allied Health

listings.name: Lakeside Chiropractic
listings.blurb: A large central-Joondalup chiropractic clinic with eight practitioners covering spinal adjustment techniques, cold laser therapy, dry needling, cupping and Graston soft-tissue work — one of the biggest chiropractic teams north of the river.
listings._source: lakesidechiro.com.au — address, phone, eight named practitioners, services confirmed; prices, email, hours not published

listings.name: Freeman Chiropractic
listings.blurb: Dr Alex Freeman brings more than twenty years of practice to complex cases, joined by Dr Joel Maylor with an exercise-science background. Hands-on care spans adjustments, dry needling and soft-tissue therapy, with bulk-billed imaging available and no GP referral needed. Both practitioners are AHPRA-registered.
listings._source: freemanchiropractic.com.au — suburb, phone, two named AHPRA practitioners confirmed; street address, prices, hours not published

listings.name: Midland Chiropractic Care
listings.blurb: Chiropractic adjustments, rehabilitation exercises, dry needling, cupping and remedial massage on Morrison Road, with prices published plainly: $70 standard consultations and $110 for new patients. Open six days including Saturdays to 3.30pm, taking DVA referrals, NDIS plans, ICWA claims and GP care plans.
listings._source: midlandchiro.com.au — full address, phone, email, hours, complete price list ($70/$99/$110) confirmed; practitioner names not published

listings.name: West Perth Osteopathy
listings.blurb: An established Murray Street osteopathic clinic offering structural osteopathy alongside the Perrin Technique, Mummy MOT postnatal assessments, massage and dry needling. Open Monday to Saturday with weekday reception, treating everyone from infants to seniors.
listings._source: westperthosteo.com.au — full address, phone, hours confirmed; prices, email, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Melville Osteopathy
listings.blurb: Osteopathy with massage, acupuncture, naturopathy and traditional Chinese medicine under one Myaree roof — a deliberately unhurried, whole-person practice that books longer appointments Monday to Saturday.
listings._source: melvilleosteopathy.com.au — full address, phones, email confirmed; prices, hours detail, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Northern Osteopathy and Podiatry
listings.blurb: A Hillarys clinic pairing osteopathy with podiatry in a mixed-modality approach — hands-on treatment combined with exercise therapy and practical wellness guidance, serving the northern beaches corridor.
listings._source: northernosteopathy.com — full address, phone, email confirmed; prices, hours, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Trained Physio & Fitness
listings.blurb: Physiotherapy and exercise physiology attached to a 24/7 gym on Brown Street: 45-minute initial consults, sports injury management, dry needling and massage, with WorkCover, motor vehicle, Medicare and DVA pathways all handled. Physio hours run early mornings to 8pm most weekdays plus weekends.
listings._source: trainedphysioperth.com.au — full address, phone, detailed weekly hours confirmed; prices, email, practitioner names not published

listings.name: PROmotion Health
listings.blurb: ESSA-accredited exercise physiologists alongside physiotherapy, pelvic health, podiatry, remedial massage and dietetics in Claremont. Programs span pre- and post-surgical rehab, teen strength, seniors' programs and hydrotherapy, with private, Medicare, DVA, NDIS and WorkCover clients all accepted — no referral needed. Open to 7pm weekdays.
listings._force_reason: Shares premises and reception phone with Nutrition Nation (whose dietitians consult from PROmotion's Claremont rooms) — distinct businesses, one venue.
listings._source: promotionhealth.com.au — full address, phone, email, hours, ESSA accreditation confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Reload Strength Clinic
listings.blurb: Chris Anastasios, an ESSA-accredited exercise physiologist, runs a strength-first clinic on Newcastle Street: orthopaedic and spinal rehabilitation, chronic condition management and sports-specific training, with objective testing on VALD ForceDecks. Medicare, DVA, workers compensation, NDIS and private health pathways accepted.
listings._source: reloadstrengthclinic.com.au — full address, phone, email, hours, named ESSA practitioner confirmed; prices not published

listings.name: Revolv Health
listings.blurb: Three accredited exercise physiologists — Thomas Le Huray, James Walker and Sharis Cooper — running a split assessment-and-prescription model from Bull Creek, with NDIS, workers compensation, DVA and GP chronic-condition plans supported. Group offerings include Strength for Life for older adults and the Girls Get Strong small-group program.
listings._source: revolvhealth.com — suburb, phone, three named AEPs confirmed; street address, prices, hours not published

listings.name: Mandurah Spine and Sport
listings.blurb: Chiropractic and physiotherapy near the Mandurah foreshore: manual adjustments and mobilisations, shockwave therapy, dry needling, cupping, clinical pilates and structured pre- and post-operative rehabilitation, open weekdays in morning and afternoon sessions.
listings._source: mandurahspineandsport.com.au — full address, phone, email, session hours confirmed; prices, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Fremantle Speech Pathology Services
listings.blurb: Running since 1987 with more than thirty speech pathologists, covering early language development, speech clarity, stuttering, literacy, feeding and mealtime management, plus school screening programs, holiday programs and telehealth. Therapy approaches include PROMPT, the Lidcombe Program, Sounds-Write and Hanen.
listings._source: freospeech.com.au — est. 1987, 30+ speech pathologists, program names confirmed; street address, phone, email, prices not published

listings.name: Finding Our Voice
listings.blurb: A Walcott Street speech pathology practice with a focus on autism and neurological diversity: assessments spanning developmental language disorder, articulation, auditory processing, executive function and dyslexia, alongside individual therapy, social groups for preteens and teens, school screening and staff training.
listings._source: findingourvoice.com.au — full address, phone, email, assessment list confirmed; prices, hours, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Perth Speech Pathology
listings.address: Level 1, 50 Subiaco Square Rd, Subiaco WA 6008
listings.blurb: Clinics in Subiaco Square and Edgewater offering children's and adult speech pathology, gender-affirming voice training, mobile visits and telehealth — one of the few practices in the metro listing adult voice work alongside paediatric therapy.
listings._source: perthspeechpathology.com.au — Subiaco address, phones, second Edgewater clinic confirmed; prices, hours, practitioner names not published

listings.name: OT West
listings.blurb: Occupational therapy for adults across neurological and physical rehabilitation, home assessments and modifications, dementia management, seating and pressure care, and palliative support — in Shenton Park rooms, in clients' homes across the metro, and by telehealth to rural and interstate clients. DVA, home care packages and Medicare chronic disease pathways accepted.
listings._source: otwest.com.au — full address, phone, email, funding pathways confirmed; prices, hours, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Inside Out Occupational Therapy
listings.blurb: Paediatric occupational therapy for children, adolescents and families: comprehensive and functional capacity assessments, an ADHD clinic, Circle of Security and Tuning into Kids programs, school screens and outreach — in clinic, at home and at school. An NDIS-approved provider with AHPRA-registered therapists.
listings._source: insideouttherapy.com.au — full address, phone, email, programs, NDIS approval confirmed; prices and hours not published

listings.name: Southern River Occupational Therapy
listings.blurb: Bea has practised paediatric occupational therapy since 1991, working across sensory processing, fine and gross motor development, motor planning, visual perception, handwriting and sleep routines for the south-eastern corridor from Canning Vale to Kelmscott. Registered with Medicare and private health funds.
listings._source: southernriveroccupationaltherapy.com.au — suburb, phones, email, 25+ years practising confirmed; street address, prices, hours not published

listings.name: Doubleview Podiatry
listings.blurb: More than thirty years of foot care on Brighton Road: orthotic therapy, sports podiatry, gait analysis, plantar fasciitis and heel pain management, fungal nail and ingrown toenail treatment, serving the coastal strip from City Beach to Karrinyup.
listings._source: doubleviewpodiatry.com.au — full address, phone, email, 30+ years confirmed; prices, hours, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Cannington Podiatry
listings.blurb: General and sports podiatry on Pattie Street with radial shockwave therapy, deep-tissue laser, podiatric joint mobilisation, nail surgery, paediatric care and orthotics. Open Monday to Thursday 9am–5.30pm and Friday mornings.
listings._source: canningtonpodiatry.com.au — full address, phone, hours, services confirmed; prices, email, practitioner names not published

listings.name: Step Ahead Podiatry
listings.blurb: An award-winning, locally owned Rockingham practice covering toenail care, diabetic foot treatment, orthotics, minor surgery and sports podiatry, with home visits available. Medicare and DVA rebates accepted, and pensioner rates offered.
listings._source: stepaheadpodiatry.com.au — full address, phone, DVA/Medicare, pensioner rates confirmed; prices, email, hours not published
